findings.subject: Cleanup exceptions can skip later resources
findings.evidence: probe_core.hpp cleanup() calls call() sequentially without a per-resource exception fallback; prefix/input/output/state string construction can throw outside logging catches. run() invokes cleanup() outside the protocol try block.
findings.requested_resolution: Attempt each applicable cleanup API independently even if journaling/string construction fails; never retry an API after it has already been invoked.

findings.subject: TX whitelist allocation inside measured API interval
findings.evidence: The WriteMsgs lambda currently constructs a Bytes vector, validates and increments next_tx between QPC samples.
findings.requested_resolution: Complete whitelist validation and state bookkeeping before the measured interval, keeping only the actual provider call between samples.

findings.subject: Launcher bookkeeping exception after child start could return before child exit
findings.resolution: wait_for_child catches bookkeeping errors and waits before returning; result includes PID, exit and bookkeeping error.

findings.subject: Qualification certificate could change between preflight and attribution
findings.resolution: Parse one certificate byte snapshot, retain hash, require exact hash after client scan; require launcher/client-check/EXE/contract pins.

findings.subject: Non-ASCII ReadVersion bytes could invalidate UTF-8 JSON
findings.resolution: quote() now escapes bytes >=127 as Unicode byte values; raw buffers remain hex.

findings.subject: BCrypt buffer lifetime on hashing error
findings.resolution: Hash object backing vector declared outside try; hash handle destroyed before backing buffer unwinds.

findings.subject: Qualification runner default input pin path
findings.resolution: Default path now probe/INPUT_PINS.json, matching builder output.

All received status/count/message fields logged before parser validation

timeout_policy.source: Parent confirmed retained RK02 policy; no new delay or retry

limitations: Review and65 synthetic same-PE tests are offline evidence only; no physical authorization or successful vehicle transition is established.
Historical physical logs do not contain a complete successful wire/API transition. The C3 reply oracle is verified stock-code offline execution; BF/C1/status16 are preserved physical evidence.

Real provider defaults and timing remain unmeasured. The retained read policy is a maximum1000ms requested slice with a2000ms between-call frame deadline, not a guarantee against OS/provider/IO stalls.
Complete cleanup is verified for ordinary returns and handled C++/journal errors; abrupt termination, native provider faults and OS failures are outside these tests.
The PE retains generic OS loader/file APIs for its gated fixed provider bootstrap and C runtime; their presence does not mean arbitrary provider/payload selection is exposed.

build_review.source_closure: Only probe/src/main.cpp and local probe headers compile; inherited src/, owned_artifact.h and acquisition bootstrap are outside this target.
build_review.binary_string_scan: Only these ten PassThru export names occur; selected acquisition/kernel/application markers absent. String scan is supplementary, not the basis of the finite-TX proof.

finite_tx_proof.data_origin: fixed_tx(stage) internal immutable three-frame table; no argument/file/response controls transmitted bytes
finite_tx_proof.callers: Probe::run invokes exchange(0), exchange(1), exchange(2), each only after preceding strict successful reply; exceptions leave protocol and enter cleanup
finite_tx_proof.guard: stage==next_tx && stage<3 at construction and dispatch; next_tx increments after each API invocation; no retry loop around transmission
finite_tx_proof.forbidden_paths: No seed/key/BEEF/session declaration/kernel upload/kernel start/ROM read/flash path is in the probe compilation closure
finite_tx_proof.binding: Reviewed source inputs match both independently produced clean PE builds; offline fixture tests invoke the selected physical PE through an early-return static fake branch.

native_bootstrap_review.limits: Forced process termination, provider crash, OS failure, and actual DLL/provider timing are not exercised by static fake qualification. DLL RAII release is distinct from verified J2534 Close status.
